content.title: Timken 6210-2RS Deep Groove Ball Bearing, 50mm Bore x 90mm OD x 20mm Width, Rubber Sealed, ABEC-1/P0
content.short_description: Timken 6210-2RS deep groove ball bearing with rubber seals on both sides, 50mm bore, 90mm OD, 20mm width, dynamic load rating of 35.1 kN.
content.long_description:
The Timken 6210-2RS is a single-row deep groove ball bearing with dimensions of 50mm bore, 90mm outer diameter, and 20mm width, corresponding to standard 6210 series envelope dimensions. The "2RS" designation indicates rubber seals fitted on both sides of the bearing, contacting the inner ring to retain lubricant and restrict entry of dust and moisture.

This bearing carries a dynamic load rating (C) of 35.1 kN, defining the constant radial load it can theoretically sustain for one million revolutions. It is manufactured to ABEC-1 / P0 precision class, the standard tolerance grade for general industrial rotating equipment applications where high-precision runout is not required.

Deep groove construction allows the 6210-2RS to support combined radial and moderate axial loads in a single unit. The sealed design suits installations where periodic relubrication access is limited or where contamination ingress is a concern, such as pumps, motors, gearboxes, and general mechanical power transmission assemblies using 50mm shaft bores.
